title: Four detectors and one place for findings
claim: GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie and AWS Config each read one kind of evidence, and Security Hub gathers their findings in one place.
alt: On the left, four kinds of evidence in an AWS account: activity logs, workloads, S3 buckets and resource configurations. Each feeds one service: Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, Amazon Macie and AWS Config. Arrows carry their findings to AWS Security Hub. From Security Hub, findings go to Amazon EventBridge, and Amazon Detective investigates one finding.

edges.say: Amazon GuardDuty analyzes activity such as CloudTrail management events, VPC flow logs and DNS logs.
Amazon Inspector scans workloads for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure.
Amazon Macie discovers sensitive data in Amazon S3.
AWS Config records how each resource is configured over time.
AWS Security Hub receives the findings of these services in one place.
Findings go on to Amazon EventBridge, and Amazon Detective helps you find the root cause of one finding.
